title: Lucky-cat temple · Setagaya Boro-ichi · Harajuku streetwear crawl · Shibuya Sky sunset · Uoshin and karaoke

stops.name: Leave Ninja House
stops.plan: Out the door at 07:20 with passports (tax-free) and cash for the flea market; grab konbini coffee and onigiri on the walk.
stops.transport: Walk to Ochiai-minami-nagasaki, Toei Oedo line to Higashi-Nakano, JR Chuo-Sobu local to Shinjuku, Odakyu line to Gōtokuji, then walk (about 80 min)

stops.name: Gōtokuji
stops.plan: The lucky-cat temple before the crowds: hundreds of maneki-neko by the shrine hall; buy one each for the trip.
stops.transport: Walk to the Boro-ichi street (Daikan Yashiki), 14 min

stops.name: Setagaya Boro-ichi (year-end flea market)
stops.plan: The 440-year-old flea market on its last day of the year (09:00–20:00): daikan-mochi for a second breakfast, then split into pairs for vintage, antiques and junk; meet at the Daikan Yashiki at 10:45.
stops.transport: Tokyu Setagaya line Kamimachi → Yamashita, Odakyu line Gōtokuji → Yoyogi-Uehara, Tokyo Metro Chiyoda line to Meiji-jingumae, then walk (about 45 min)

stops.name: atmos Harajuku (sneakers)
stops.plan: Start the streetwear crawl at atmos; check the app raffles a week ahead for any drop.

stops.name: HUMAN MADE TOKYO (global flagship)
stops.plan: HUMAN MADE's first global flagship: the Tokyo-only pieces go first, so hit it before lunch.

stops.name: Harajuku Gyōza Rō
stops.plan: Fast, cheap lunch: plates of fried and boiled gyoza and beer; cash only, the queue moves quickly.

stops.name: KICKS LAB. (Pino Harajuku)
stops.plan: Rare and deadstock sneakers (opens 13:00 on weekdays).

stops.name: Cat Street / Ura-Hara
stops.plan: Wander Ura-Hara and Cat Street: 2nd Street and the backstreet vintage shops; meet at the Cat Street end at 14:45.

stops.name: BAPE STORE Harajuku
stops.plan: Last stop of the crawl: BAPE camo and the Harajuku-only tees; keep receipts at ¥5,000+ per person per shop for tax-free.
stops.transport: Walk to Omotesando, Tokyo Metro Ginza line to Shibuya, walk to Scramble Square (about 17 min)

stops.name: Shibuya Sky (sunset slot)
stops.plan: 15:40 entry booked for all 8 in one order (online, from-15:00 price): Fuji in the last daylight, sunset about 16:30, then the city lights. Bags in the 46F lockers.
stops.transport: Walk to Shibuya PARCO via the Scramble Crossing, 10 min

stops.name: Shibuya PARCO (Nintendo Tokyo, Pokémon Center Shibuya, Capcom, Jump Shop)
stops.plan: 6F: Nintendo TOKYO, Pokémon Center Shibuya, Capcom Store and Jump Shop (to 21:00).

stops.name: Uoshin Shibuya
stops.plan: ¥6,800 course for 8 in the semi-private room (phone 03-3464-3000): ten dishes including crab and the overflowing nokke-zushi, with all-you-can-drink.

stops.name: Karaoke Manekineko (Shibuya)
stops.plan: One room for all 8 (phone-book for 3+): free-drink plan and the anthems; one-drink minimum and photo ID to join. Leave at 23:40 sharp for the last trains.
stops.transport: JR Yamanote line Shibuya 23:59 → Ikebukuro, Seibu Ikebukuro line 00:23 → Higashi-Nagasaki, then walk (21 min); two taxis (about ¥1,500 pp) if you miss the last Seibu local

stops.name: Back at Ninja House
stops.plan: Home by about 00:40; tomorrow is an early sumo morning in Ryōgoku.
